name: Tic Tac Toe Online 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Tic-Tac-Toe online is a classic puzzle board game of naughts and crosses that never goes out of style! Whether you’re looking to challenge your wits against other players worldwide, test your strategy against a cunning computer opponent, or enjoy a friendly match with someone right next to you in local multiplayer, this game has you covered.
